codeReview.summary: Fail. Commit c4a6e76 fixes the mutex race regressions, restores the Unix direct-SIGKILL fallback in ProcessService, expands Convex validation error categorization, removes the orphaned convex/httpApi.ts path, fixes test.mjs, and removes the extra child_process import from automation routes. But the rerun only partially repairs the earlier HTTP compatibility regressions: multiple /api/profiles endpoints still no longer preserve their previous 500 error contract, and /api/workflows/artifacts/download still returns the shared 503 error path instead of the legacy 502 response.

issues.description: The original profile-contract blocker is still present for the asyncHandler-only routes at lines 36 and 108-166. Those handlers now fall through to the global middleware at server/index.ts:105-119, which serializes AppError failures as { success:false, error:{...} } and untyped failures as a generic 500 INTERNAL_ERROR body. Before the refactor, server/api/profiles.ts preserved route-local res.status(500).json({ error: message }) handling across these paths (historical lines 100, 113, 369, 425, 435, 448, 462, 476, 486, 500, 517, and 534). The fix only converted create/update/delete to AppError(500), so the prior blocking compatibility regression for multiple profile endpoints was not fully resolved.

The workflow HTTP contract is still only partially restored. GET /api/workflows/artifacts/download still throws ExternalServiceError at line 90, and server/shared/errors.ts:41-43 maps that class to HTTP 503; the global middleware at server/index.ts:108-110 then returns the shared envelope instead of the legacy body. In the pre-refactor server/api/workflows.ts, the same upstream failure returned res.status(502).json({ error: `Failed to download artifact (${upstream.status})` }) at line 195, and the run/stop failures likewise returned legacy { error: string } bodies at lines 219, 225, 438, and 453. This rerun corrected the mutex placement and the 400/429 statuses, but it still does not fully restore the prior workflow error semantics.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The repository has an undocumented tracked-vs-ignored split under tests/convex: tests/ is gitignored, but only some Convex tests are force-tracked. Workers editing one of the ignored-but-untracked tests must remember to git add -f it or the change stays out of the commit.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: .gitignore:182 ignores tests/. git ls-files -- tests/convex tracks files such as tests/convex/httpApi.test.ts and tests/convex/redteam-profiles-negative-limit.test.ts, while files present on disk like tests/convex/workflowArtifacts.test.ts, tests/convex/redteam-lists-workflow-links.test.ts, tests/convex/redteam-workflows-instant-activate.test.ts, tests/convex/redteam-workflows-invalid-schedule.test.ts, and tests/convex/redteam-workflows-terminal-transition.test.ts are not in the index. This exception is not documented in the mission AGENTS or .factory/library/architecture.md.

summary: Reviewed the fix feature handoff, transcript skeleton, refactor-worker skill, current code, commit c4a6e76, and all five prior failing scrutiny reviews. The mutex, ProcessService, Convex categorizer, httpApi cleanup, test.mjs path, and child_process-import fixes look correct, but the rerun still fails because the profile and workflow HTTP error-contract regressions were only partially addressed.
